parameters.name: nfInstanceID
parameters.description: Unique ID of the NF Instance to deregister

schema.description: String uniquely identifying a NF instance. The format of the NF Instance ID shall be a  Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) version 4, as described in IETF RFC 4122.

constraints: The nfInstanceID parameter must be provided in the path.
The nfInstanceID must be a string.
The nfInstanceID must be in the format of a UUID version 4.
